rules.droppable_only_here: A card can drop in a location only if it is in that location's pool. Every duel won in an area of that location (story duels, rematches, ambushes) and every arena bout rolls from that location's pool. Duels in castle_top use 'hall'. cistern and ship_deck keep their story rewards only.
rules.roll: 1) pick the context's odds (economy.json drop_odds), add the level shift (levels.json), 2) drop rarities with no available card (min_level, arena_only for non-arena contexts) fall to the next lower rarity, 3) pick a card of that rarity by weight.
rules.min_level: C from level 1; B from the location's arrival level; A arrival+3; S arrival+6 (S is arena_only)
rules.banned: no ritual cards, ritual-only or ritual-result monsters, no Exodia pieces, no card whose slot the old story replaced with a custom card ([309, 318, 342, 652, 653, 657, 672, 689, 702, 720]), no password-less monster over power 1950 (the legends)
rules.rarity: monsters: power = max(ATK, 0.9 DEF): C <= 1250, B <= 1700, A <= 2100, S above (S only from a per-location whitelist). Fields, Red Medicine, Sparks, Cursebreaker, Hinotama = C; equips and Mooyan Curry = B; Swords of Revealing Light and Stop Defense = A.
rules.weights: weight 3 = featured (signature) card of the location, else 1
